Get the old edition. Don't get the new one.

Kevin Trudeau recommends the original Psycho-Cybernetics by Maxwell Maltz and is blunt about the rewritten version: no good.

He says the book is about self-image and how it shapes what you experience in life. To understand how your mind works, he says, start there.

How do you picture yourself right now?

#ad #mind #success #confidence

Five days a week. One hour. Phone off, door locked.

Kevin Trudeau describes the routine he keeps pointing to: door shut and locked, phone off, no notifications, no vibrations, no distractions and no interruptions.

The goal is to learn something new every single day, as best you can. It is simple, but it asks for your full attention.

When did you last give yourself one hour with no distractions?

#ad #success #habits #focus

Broke performers, scraping by, and then they read one book.

Kevin Trudeau talks about The Science of Getting Rich, an older book that the movie The Secret was based on. He then tells of Hollywood performers who started out obscure and rarely got work, and who read The Magic of Believing.

They said it taught them to use their mind to create their reality. Kevin calls it a powerful book.

What have you read that changed how you think?
